text:
maya: fyi compliance pinged again. they want a clear 'who changed routing' story that shows up in audit exports and in-console. Right now Rollouts shows a diff but audit exports only have a generic 'policy_update' event. we should unify.

omar: agreed. Suggest event shape include routing_policy_id, action, actor_id, change_ref (blob id), change_summary, and retention_policy_id. consumers can fetch the full blob when needed.

jen: two constraints: export quotas (we can't inline whole model of changes for every update) and customer PII. proposal: small inline summary plus presigned blob for full payload, with exposure_level tag so the export pipeline can redact/require approval.

sam: sample event payload (inline NDJSON row):
```
{"event_type":"route_policy_change","routing_policy_id":"rp_0x9","actor_id":"u_maya","action":"update","change_summary":"moved 20% traffic from pool-a to pool-b","change_ref":"blob_20260317_9f","change_size_bytes":"4820","exposure_level":"sensitive","tenant_id":"t_acme","retention_policy_id":"rp_long_term"}
```
Consumers GET `/audit/blobs/:change_ref` with short-lived creds.

lex: add actor_hint (sha256 of email) + actor_resolution_status so customers can map without raw emails. also recommend a human_readable_anchor like "Rollout #42" for console linking.

jen: legal asked about retention/redaction: contractors must be redacted after 90d. We can emit redaction_flags on the event and keep full details encrypted in the blob. Exports only surface "sensitive details omitted" unless the requester has approval.

maya: UX idea for Console: in audit row show summary, small badge for exposure_level, and a "view full diff" button that fetches presigned blob (requires permission). For export flow, include change_ref and a tiny diff_summary.

sam: telemetry we should emit: route_policy_change_event_count, presigned_blob_fetch_count, export_bytes (per-tenant), and change_blob_generation_latency. I'll add those to the PR.

infra-bot: deploy: audit-blobs-service v2 -> prod (ok) 1751234100

omar: one more thought: versioning for blobs. change_ref should be stable and include schema_version so older consumers can still parse. e.g., blob_v2:20260317:9f.

maya: plan: sam will open PR for schema + ndjson export example (inline summary only). jen will draft retention/redaction rules and UI copy. omar will update API docs. we'll reconvene after PR review.

maya: thanks all, using this thread as the source of truth for the implementation plan.
